newsitem.title: POLAND: Polisa sees 1997 net up to PLN 5.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polisa sees 1997 net up to PLN 5.7 mln.

text.p: Polish insurer Polisa SA expects to lift net profit this year to 5.7 million zlotys from 3.76 million zlotys in 1996, the firm's president said on Monday.
Stanislaw Gutek told a news conference that the firm made a loss of 1.7 million zlotys in this year's first quarter versus its 11.7-million-zloty loss in the same period last year.
Gutek said that in the first quarter the firm increased investment to 77 million zlotys from 35 million zlotys in the same period the year.
Jan Socha, president of Polisa's 37.47-percent-owned subsidiary Agropolisa SA, told the conference that next week his firm would begin selling its first policies designed for farmers.
